name: Subaru Warren
source:
Favorite Food: Chinese Three Day Feast
The All Mighty Idiot Rich Boy

He was born in New York and raised in California.
His father is the CEO of a giant American corporation, and his mother a Japanese from Yokohama.
He's always been interested in Japan since he was a kid, so to get away from his overprotective father he came by himself to Japan.
A confident guy who thinks there isn't anything that he can't obtain and is a bit overbearing and straightforward when expressing what he thinks.
